scope: single-model public G6 mismatch correction, Q blind-truth calibration, and LU/U paired causal calibration

findings.title: Formal statistical validity is not established
findings.evidence: A new isolated Q blind-truth calibration made 24 real kimi-k2.5 provider calls (24 structured responses). Its truth key was generated before execution and was never read by the runner or sent to the model; independent derivative-sign scoring gives TRUTH_MATCH=24/24. The frozen Q-v2 92-case denominator and its nonconfirmatory counts remain unchanged. The calibration is public supplementary evidence, not a replacement for domain-grade blinded review of the frozen cohort.
findings.remediation: Retain the 24/24 public calibration as supplementary evidence and obtain an independent domain-grade blinded review for the frozen 92-case cohort before scientific release.

findings.title: LU/U formal causal validation is not established
findings.evidence: A new public paired control/intervention calibration made 24 primary kimi-k2.5 calls plus 6 visible format retries (30 traces total). The independent public truth key validates 5 complete causal contrasts; all remaining mismatches and NOT_SCORED records are retained. This does not retroactively relabel the historical LU/U observations or convert the formal G7 U denominator into a causal estimate.
findings.remediation: Retain the paired calibration and obtain protocol-approved causal validation on the formal LU/U population; do not pool the calibration into the historical G7 denominator.

findings.title: G6 public mathematical inconsistencies remain
findings.evidence: The new public-only corrective cohort targeted exactly the 43 rows identified by the v7 boundary review and made 54 kimi-k2.5 provider calls, including 11 visible format retries. Independent chain-of-custody audit passes for all 43 rows; 35 candidates are structurally valid, 19 align with the public boundary witness, 16 still disagree, and 3 have candidate-quality defects. The historical 43 mismatches remain immutable and are not retroactively changed.
findings.remediation: Keep the historical 43 failures and new correction evidence separate; obtain independent mathematical/domain review and a protocol-approved reanalysis before changing G6 scientific status.

findings.title: G7 historical lifecycle failures remain part of the record
findings.evidence: The v7 state remains 150/150 states and 72/72 checkpoints with 13/13 valid new retries, while all 13 historical lifecycle errors remain preserved. No v8 cohort edits or deletes those historical rows.
findings.remediation: Keep historical lifecycle failures and corrected retry evidence in separate append-only views; require protocol-approved reanalysis for any formal denominator change.

interpretation: Execution and public calibration advanced, but the scientific release gate remains BLOCKED. New public calibration truth is not silently substituted for the frozen formal cohorts, and historical G6/G7 failures remain immutable.
